digest.component_or_area: CI/CD test infrastructure and pytest workflow
propositions: Every CI test phase over 1 second must be audited for unique failure mode, faster overlapping coverage, prior rejection, and safe remediation without changing tests or workflows.

The three most recent successful Gerrit Verify runs (22–26 minutes wall clock) show no individual pytest setup/call/teardown phase exceeding 30s; sampled CI maximum was 22.63s, local exhaustive maximum 21.96s integration.

Gerrit 1817 merged 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes off macOS and Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 into Ubuntu 3.13 only, reducing ~8s macOS wall and 24.84 runner-seconds; no organic descendant patchset has yet measured post-merge delta.

501 unique ≥1s phases inventoried from local exhaustive pass and CI top-25 logs; families disposition-mapped to keep, refactor, or move with cited failure modes and coverage rationale; no CLI/workflow/test/dispatch change made.
